{{Quote|Escarte?''"<br />"''An asteroid mining facility, belonging to the Commerce Guild.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[TC-16]]|<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>}}
'''Escarte''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility which belonged to the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|240|Escarte}}</ref> Located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], in the [[Escarte system/Legends|Escarte system]], it [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] between massive, multi[[Moon/Legends|mooned]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in an otherwise uninhabited [[Star system/Legends|star system]] two [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps from [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]], on the Rimward side of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. Oblate when mining operations had commenced in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], Escarte was, by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a concave hemisphere, heavily cratered by the forces of nature and the gargantuan labor [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of the Commerce Guild. Satisfied that every bit of [[Ore/Legends|ore]] had been extracted from Escarte, the guild had converted the asteroid’s consequent quarries, tunnels, and shafts into [[Ore processing center|processing centers]] and field offices. State-of-the-art [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] technology allowed the guild to capture small asteroids and draw them directly into the facility, rather than have to use [[Spacetug/Legends|tugs]] or engage in on-site mining. In many ways Escarte was the ore-mining equivalent of the [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]]-gas-mining facilities that floated in dense [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], far across the stars.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />

They controlled the asteroid with the [[Escarte Judiciary]] and the [[Escarte Guard/Legends|Escarte Guard]], and it was defended by Commerce Guild [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] and [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] patrol craft modeled on the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to deter intruders approaching from [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. In the late [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] had managed to insert one of its [[Agent/Legends|agents]] onto Escarte. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] went there in search of [[Thal K'sar]], the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Artisan/Legends|artisan]] who had crafted [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray’s]] [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]], as another lead the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were pursuing in their hunt for [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="CSWE" />
